question: Which representations of the same two-layer climate energy-balance state support an unaugmented linear Markov model that preserves both physical thermal modes, and what is lost through scalar projection or gained only redundantly through naive concatenation?
hypothesis: On the declared two-layer EBM control, PyDMD recovers the exact fast and slow decay timescales from every rank-two temperature, heat-flux, or modal representation; an unaugmented one-coordinate Markov representation cannot resolve both state modes; concatenating equivalent full-state views adds observed dimensions without adding dynamical rank and exposes severe conditioning rather than new physical information. These mode-recovery statements are distinct from Kalman observability of a scalar output over time.

datasets.grid: not spatially resolved; ten deterministic off-equilibrium paired state realizations
datasets.time_domain: one-year exact state-transition pairs about a unit-step-forcing equilibrium

units_metadata.thermal_modes: coordinates induced by the exact linear generator eigenbasis with the reference's declared heat-capacity normalization

datasets.quality_control_policy: physical parameters must be finite and positive; representation maps are exact deterministic functions of the same paired physical states; non-finite samples or invalid decay spectra fail closed

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: maximum relative error against the exact fast and slow EBM timescales across temperature-state, heat-flux, thermal-mode, temperature-plus-flux, and all-full-rank-view representations
primary_metrics.missing_data_policy: both recovered modes are required for every rank-two representation condition
primary_metrics.uncertainty_method: deterministic noiseless structural control; no sampling interval claimed

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: minimum DMD mode count across all declared rank-two representation conditions
primary_metrics.missing_data_policy: each representation must return two finite real decay modes

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: maximum resolved mode count over surface-temperature-only and TOA-imbalance-only unaugmented scalar Markov representations
minimum one-step reconstruction error across the two scalar projection controls
secondary_metrics.missing_data_policy: both scalar controls must report finite prediction error

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: minimum observed dimension minus matrix rank across temperature-plus-flux and all-full-rank-view concatenations
secondary_metrics.missing_data_policy: dimension and numerical matrix rank are required for both concatenated controls

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: sample-matrix condition number reported separately for each redundant concatenated representation
secondary_metrics.missing_data_policy: each redundant concatenation reports rank_deficient or a finite condition number explicitly; no Infinity, NaN, regularization, or finite sentinel is allowed

negative_controls: project the two-reservoir state to surface temperature alone and require the unaugmented rank-one Markov representation to expose that it cannot resolve two independent thermal modes in one state coordinate
project the same state to TOA imbalance alone as a second rank-one Markov-closure control; do not interpret this as a claim of control-theoretic unobservability over time
concatenate temperature and heat-flux views even though both are invertible maps of the same two-dimensional state and report the resulting redundant dimensions and conditioning
concatenate temperature, heat-flux, and exact modal views and verify that six observed coordinates still span only the original two-dimensional dynamical state
falsifiers: any declared rank-two representation fails to recover both exact thermal decay timescales within 2e-11 relative error
a scalar unaugmented representation is reported as resolving two independent Markov state modes despite having matrix rank one
temperature-plus-flux or all-view concatenation is treated as adding dynamical degrees of freedom when its matrix rank remains two
the DMD implementation is silently replaced or given exact target timescales during fitting
representation samples no longer refer to identical paired physical EBM states across views
split_policy: not applicable to this deterministic structural control; noisy, learned, or observational follow-on experiments require distinct estimation and confirmation data
preprocessing: no learned preprocessing or target-informed scaling; each representation is an explicit deterministic map of the same exact EBM state pairs and DMD rank is fixed to the intended unaugmented representation rank
stopping_rule: the reference experiment is retained only if every rank-two view recovers both exact modes, both scalar controls expose one-mode recovery for the unaugmented one-coordinate Markov model without being mislabeled as unobservable, and both concatenated controls expose redundant dimensions without being credited as additional physical state
multiple_comparison_policy: all declared representation conditions and controls are reported; no condition is selected after inspecting recovery error
